description: Post an incoming supplier invoice with PO reference (MIRO equivalent). Runs the 3-way match first and books ONLY if every line matches; deviations come back as a question for a human instead of a posting (allow_deviation only after a human approved). Also refuses a second invoice with the same supplier_reference for the same supplier. WRITES — permission gate + write log; dry run unless the connection is live.

allow_deviation.description: true = book despite 3-way-match deviations; only after human approval

company_code.description: SAP company code to post in

dry_run.description: true = build and log the request but send nothing. Writes are ALWAYS dry runs while the tenant's SAP connection has write_mode "dry_run" (the default).

gross_amount.description: Gross invoice amount in document currency

lines.description: Invoice lines with PO reference (PO, PO item, quantity, amount, unit)

amount.description: net amount of the line in document currency

purchase_order.description: SAP purchase order number the line refers to

purchase_order_item.description: Item number within the purchase order

park.description: true = park the invoice in SAP instead of posting it; 'bei_abweichung' = park only when the 3-way match deviates (instead of asking back). A duplicate invoice number is always refused.

name: create_sap_supplier_invoice
